name: bondi-uy
description: Publishes the BondiUY web demo (build/web) as a Cloudflare Worker. The app itself is Flutter: see README.md.

scripts.deploy: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/bondi.ps1 web && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/bondi.ps1 web && npx wrangler deploy --env staging
